description: Watercolour wildflower meadow mural 1536x1024 (about 3:2) on a warm ivory watercolour-paper background: pink and peach cosmos, honey-yellow daisies, white chamomile, baby's breath and tiny pink flowers on sage-green stems fill the lower half of the wall; six small watercolour butterflies float in the airy cream upper half. Soft pastel, storybook mood for a girl's room or nursery.
